description: This file defines the ProductImageCropUtils class, which provides utilities for cropping images, including determining if cropping is possible, calculating crop areas, and performing crop operations on BufferedImage objects.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cropping images, handling crop area calculations, and determining crop feasibility based on image dimensions.

methods.name: ProductImageCropUtils
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the utility with an image and target dimensions, and determines if cropping is feasible.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines if the image can be cropped based on its dimensions and target specifications.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area dimensions and checks for size consistency.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped image from a file based on specified coordinates and dimensions.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped BufferedImage based on pre-calculated crop area.
